title: IT - Full Stack Developer
jobDescription:
Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. Department Overview Company Overview: At Motorola Solutions, we create technologies our customers refer to as their lifeline. Our technology platforms in communications, software, video and services help our customers work safely and more efficiently. Whether it’s helping firefighters see through smoke, enabling police officers to see around street corners, or reliably keeping the lights on in homes and businesses around the world, our work supports those who put their lives on the line to keep us safe. Bring your passion, potential and talent to Motorola Solutions, and help us usher in a new era in public safety and security. Department Overview: Our IT organization has a critical role in driving extraordinary business results. Through a strong partnership with other areas of our business, we bring innovative thinking to every conversation and deliver with integrity. We’re looking for people who bring great ideas and who make our partners’ ideas better. Intellectually curious advisors (not order takers) who focus on outcomes to creatively solve business problems. People who not only embrace change, but who accelerate it. Job Description Within the Digital Program at MSI IT, we’re passionate about building software that solves problems. We count on our Full Stack Developers (FSDs) to empower our users with a rich feature set, high availability, and stellar performance level to pursue their missions. As we expand our customer deployments, we are currently seeking a FSD to understand our IT systems and applications requirements and help build new applications or enhance existing applications. Specifically, we are searching for someone who brings fresh ideas, demonstrates a unique and informed viewpoint, and enjoys collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop real-world solutions and positive user experiences at every interaction. As a FSD, you will be responsible for business and IT stakeholders interaction, requirements analysis, designing the systems, execute the development efforts of the Digital Transformation platform & help us meet the business requirements, enrich the customer experience and satisfaction and improve the quality of the software applications. Objectives of this

ROLE:
Interact with various IT and business stakeholders, teams to understand various applications functioning Identify business and IT needs and translate them into the technical and functional requirements Develop software and systems to manage platform infrastructure and applications Improve reliability, quality, and time-to-market of our suite of software solutions Measure and optimize system performance, with an eye toward pushing our capabilities forward, getting ahead of customer needs, and innovating for continuous improvement Provide support and engineering for multiple large distributed software applications Keep applications, software and hardware up to date. Daily and Monthly Responsibilities Partner with development teams to deliver the planned deliverables Meet with IT leaders to discuss project goals, solution quality, schedule and progress, and the overall client relationship. Estimate the work required to implement a module of a project. Test your work and review team members’ work and give constructive feedback on improvements. Serve as the technical lead on multiple active project initiatives. Assist in the creation of design documents and key artifacts for the project. Leverage internal tools, standards, and processes for the development work. Help peers and junior team members debug code or resolve technical problems. Drive client satisfaction through repeated project delivery successes and strategic engagement. Additional Accountabilities: Complex Issue Triage (Across multiple technology platforms and vendors) Establish best practices for performance and stability Conduct monthly reviews to review trends and change recommendations Review and maintain list of corrective actions Basic Requirements Bachelor of engineering or BSc in Computer Science or Information Technology. 7+ years of software development experience in the IT industry. Sound development experience using Angular, React, Java Script, Node.js, Python, .NET, XML, JQuery, Javascript, Json and other similar web technologies. Expert in developing APIs and web Services (SOAP and RESTFUL). Extensive RDBMS database working knowledge (DML SQLs, Stored Procedures/Functions/Triggers development) using Postgre SQL, Oracle, SQL Server, My SQL databases. Experience with development frameworks including Angular JS, Angular or React JS, and Node.js. Strong HTML/CSS/Java Script skills. A proactive approach to spotting problems, areas for improvement, and performance bottlenecks. Experience in developing, testing/debugging web, console, desktop applications in e-Commerce, Services, finance, billing and payment, user and account management, insurance, banking domains. Hands-on experience in various AI tools like GH Copilot, Gemini, Claude, Cursor, etc. Familiarity with responsive design/development best practices. Excellent analytical and problem solving skills. Good written and oral communication skills. Familiarity with accessible web design & development practices. Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS. Exposure to lead the software development team and mentor them to build a high performing team. Should be able to manage work independently. Must be familiar with various types of testing, defect prevention activities & Quality Management. Well aware of CI/CD processes and having experience using Dev Ops tools like Bitbucket, Jenkins, Jira, Git, Confluence, version control, etc. Travel Requirements None Relocation Provided None Position Type Experienced Referral Payment Plan Yes EEO Statement Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic. We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team. MOTOROLA SOLUTIONS OVERVIEW At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. Learn more at www.motorolasolutions.com. This role requires proficiency in C/C++, Python, or Node.js, along with a collaborative mindset and a passion for tackling challenging projects using cutting-edge technologies. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver and a strong communicator eager to contribute to a dynamic team environment and guide the development of junior engineers.

Collaborate with team to understand project requirements and deliver solutions. Participate in code reviews and contribute to team knowledge sharing. Debug and resolve software defects and issues. Identify the gaps in the existing manual workflow/process and try to automate Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies to ensure continuous improvement. Should be willing to grasp/share knowledge with the team Basic Requirements

Hands-on experience in Vo IP functional testing and core telecom protocols (SIP, RTP/RTCP, DNS, HTTP, SSL/TLS, TCP/UDP) Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Knowledge of version control systems (e.g., Git). Excellent communication and teamwork skills. Eagerness to learn and adapt to new technologies and methodologies. Our end-to-end suite of software solutions helps our customers answer thousands of emergency calls and text messages, and process video, disparate evidence and records. Calipsa, which is part of MSI, is aiming at automating CCTV video monitoring. We are building a cloud-based platform that automatically connects with cameras, processes and analyzes their content and only forward actionable alerts to our customers. We are working with the biggest security companies in the world, actively monitoring over 25 thousand sites worldwide. We are expecting to massively grow the number of cameras and traffic on our platform in the near future. Our cloud-based platform connects seamlessly with all cameras regardless of their brand or model and processes a wide range of analytics in real-time. You will be part of a small growing team who will focus on achieving robust and scalable architecture in order to enable millions of alarms to be processed on our platform. You will be developing features that enable customers to get more insight and intelligence from their cameras. Everything that you do will need to scale as it will serve hundreds of thousands of cameras all around the world. Being able to make accurate estimates and deliver them is crucial in order to manage expectations from internal and external stakeholders. Frontend Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with Vue.js (or React). Backend Pipeline Ownership: Proven track record of developmeing complex, heavy-load backend pipelines, including message queue systems (e.g., Rabbit MQ, Kafka, SQS). API & Networking: Strong experience designing and maintaining Open API specifications. Teamwork: Demonstrated strong team player skills with a collaborative approach to engineering. Scalable Systems: Excitement about building, operating, and architecting resilient, high-throughput systems that impact a global community of users. Observability & Performance: Proactive drive for observability (monitoring, logging, tracing) to diagnose problems and optimize system performance. Distributed Work: Comfortable working asynchronously in a highly distributed, remote-first team environment across multiple time zones. title: Principle AI Research Engineer
jobDescription: Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. Department Overview Based in Bengaluru, India, the AI Scientist will be a hands-on technical contributor responsible for designing, developing, and deploying state-of-the-art machine learning models that power Motorola Solutions’ mission-critical security and public safety products. This role requires deep technical acumen in specific AI domains, focusing on translating research into scalable, high-performance production systems. The AI Scientist will be a core member of our central AI organization, contributing directly to the foundational models and algorithms consumed by downstream product teams. Key Responsibilities The AI Scientist will be responsible for the research, development, and delivery of AI/ML models across the following core areas: Model Research & Development: Conduct end-to-end development of AI/ML models from initial concept and literature review through to production deployment and monitoring. Data Lifecycle Management: Collaborate with data engineering teams on large-scale dataset creation, annotation, quality control, and pipeline optimization to ensure high-quality training data. Algorithm Optimization: Focus on optimizing model performance for real-time and edge deployment constraints, including latency, throughput, and computational efficiency. Specialized AI Focus in at one of or more of the following areas: Voice AI/Natural Language Processing: Evaluate, adapt and/or train robust speech recognition, translation, natural language understanding, and audio understanding models tailored for noisy, real-world public safety and security environments. Computer Vision & Video Analytics: Develop and enhance models for complex object detection, tracking, re-identification, video search capabilities, and scene understanding from diverse video sources. Foundational Model Fine-Tuning: Evaluate, fine-tune, and adapt large pre-trained and foundational models (e.g., LLMs, large vision models) for specific security-focused tasks and domain-specific knowledge integration. Collaboration: Partner with software engineers to integrate models into the enterprise-scale cloud and edge AI platforms, ensuring reliability and scalability. Evaluation & Validation: Establish rigorous, metric-driven evaluation frameworks (e.g., Precision, Recall, F1-Score) to benchmark model performance and drive continuous improvement on quantifiable customer outcomes. Job Description As an AI Research Scientist, you will be part of a multidisciplinary team of engineers and researchers in our AI R&D team. Our goal is to build advanced vision models that contribute to a safer world. Your responsibilities will include researching, designing, and developing the underlying algorithms to solve practical problems, creating prototypes, and collaborating with various product development teams to deliver high-quality solutions for both edge computing and cloud environments. Key Responsibilities Conduct cutting-edge research in machine learning and computer vision, focusing on solutions for public safety and video security. Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in the field by regularly reviewing published research papers. Generate high-quality patents in applied computer vision. Collaborate with software development teams to deploy the vision models you design and train. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the organization's machine learning deployment processes and tools. Basic Requirements: Ph D in a technical field. 5+ years of professional experience in applied AI research. A deep understanding of Transformer architectures and Vision-Language Models. Experience in Python programming and working with deep learning frameworks such as Py Torch. Differentiators: Experience in C++ programming and working with embedded systems. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Proven ability to write clean, efficient, and well-documented production-level code. Experience in Python programming and working with deep learning frameworks such as Py Torch. Department Overview We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our core engineering team to design and develop a high-throughput, mission-critical active-active microservice framework responsible for dynamically routing and balancing traffic across multi-site deployments based on real-time health, capacity, and geolocation metrics. Job Description Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop the core Load Distribution engine using Finite State Machines (FSM) to manage dynamic homing, execute Weighted Average Score (WAS) algorithms, and implement hysteresis. Architect high-throughput API and messaging layers using g RPC for metrics ingestion and Rabbit MQ (RMQ) for event-driven communication. Implement distributed leader election and consensus mechanisms utilizing Consul Raft and Lock Authority across active-active deployments. Ensure system scalability to handle 3,000+ assignments per second while integrating Apache Ignite/Grid Gain for stateless caching and data recovery. Required Skills & Experience: Deep hands-on experience in Golang (preferred) and proficiency in C, C++, or Java. Strong computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms. Deep understanding of distributed systems, multi-threading, concurrency control, and Finite State Machines (FSM). Hands-on expertise with networking and messaging protocols including g RPC, Protobuf v3, and Rabbit MQ. Strong background with distributed databases like Apache Ignite and Grid Gain, and consensus tools like Consul Raft and Lock Authority. Practical knowledge of persistence and caching solutions such as Postgre SQL, Redis, and Elastic Search. Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and explaining complex ideas. Industry Experience
- 1 to 10 years. Basic Requirements Proven ability to design active-active multi-site architectures handling network partitions, majority/minority quorums, and site-isolation scenarios. Experience with large-volume transaction systems, data migration workflows, and end-to-end observability frameworks like Open Telemetry and Kibana. Familiarity with enterprise security tooling such as Vault and m TLS. Background in automated deployments using Docker and CI/CD pipelines. jobDescription:

Department Overview We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our core engineering team to design and develop a high-throughput, mission-critical active-active microservice framework responsible for dynamically routing and balancing traffic across multi-site deployments based on real-time health, capacity, and geolocation metrics. Job Description Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop the core Load Distribution engine using Finite State Machines (FSM) to manage dynamic homing, execute Weighted Average Score (WAS) algorithms, and implement hysteresis. Architect high-throughput API and messaging layers using g RPC for metrics ingestion and Rabbit MQ (RMQ) for event-driven communication. Implement distributed leader election and consensus mechanisms utilizing Consul Raft and Lock Authority across active-active deployments. Ensure system scalability to handle 3,000+ assignments per second while integrating Apache Ignite/Grid Gain for stateless caching and data recovery. Required Skills & Experience: Deep hands-on experience in Golang (preferred) and proficiency in C, C++, or Java. Strong computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms. Deep understanding of distributed systems, multi-threading, concurrency control, and Finite State Machines (FSM). Hands-on expertise with networking and messaging protocols including g RPC, Protobuf v3, and Rabbit MQ. Strong background with distributed databases like Apache Ignite and Grid Gain, and consensus tools like Consul Raft and Lock Authority. Practical knowledge of persistence and caching solutions such as Postgre SQL, Redis, and Elastic Search. Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and explaining complex ideas. Industry Experience
- 1 to 10 years. Basic Requirements Proven ability to design active-active multi-site architectures handling network partitions, majority/minority quorums, and site-isolation scenarios. Experience with large-volume transaction systems, data migration workflows, and end-to-end observability frameworks like Open Telemetry and Kibana. Familiarity with enterprise security tooling such as Vault and m TLS. Background in automated deployments using Docker and CI/CD pipelines. Department Overview The CPS Applications team provides trusted, intelligent common services that streamline customer adoption and enable the secure, friction-free utilization of all Motorola Solutions (MSI) applications. The team's mission is built on three key pillars: accelerating time-to-value through frictionless onboarding, unifying the application ecosystem by building a secure core for a cohesive multi-app experience, and fueling business growth by providing operational intelligence to inform product strategy and sales. They serve a wide range of customers, including both internal MSI employees and external groups like department admins, IT admins, and end users, through services such as Unified ID SSO, Authorization (AMS), and Audit. Ultimately, the team acts as a strategic force multiplier across the MSI portfolio by delivering foundational services that simplify hybrid operations and innovate through AI-driven solutions. Job Description Motorola Solutions is “solving for safer” by building a sophisticated ecosystem of mission-critical communications, AI-powered video, and command center data. To support this vision, the Core Platform & Services (CPS) Applications team is seeking a Product Manager focused on Business Intelligence and Operational Analytics. This role is pivotal in transforming raw platform data into actionable insights, building the dashboards and analytical frameworks that allow internal leaders to monitor adoption, optimize costs, and drive strategic growth across the MSI portfolio. Job Responsibilities Define BI Strategy: Lead the roadmap for internal business intelligence, identifying the key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics required by leadership to evaluate the health of the CPS ecosystem. Build & Manage Dashboards: Design, develop, and maintain high-impact BI dashboards that provide real-time visibility into application adoption, service utilization, and centralized cost management. Operational Analytics: Analyze complex datasets across hardware, software, and cloud services to identify trends, bottlenecks, and opportunities for operational efficiency. Executive Interfacing: Act as the "voice of the data" for MSI executives, translating technical telemetry into business narratives that showcase the value proposition and progress of the CPS team. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Finance, and Product teams to ensure data integrity and to automate the collection of metrics from various common services like Unified ID and AMS. Data-Driven Roadmap Support: Use internal usage data and market trends to prioritize feature backlogs and influence the broader product strategy.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Experience: At least 5 years in Product Management with a heavy emphasis on Data Analytics, BI, or Business Operations, plus 5 years of industry experience. Technical Proficiency: Strong expertise in BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) and experience working with data sourced from cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and enterprise integrations. Analytical Rigor: Demonstrated success in translating raw operational data into executive-level insights and strategic recommendations. Communication: Polished presentation skills with the ability to explain complex data trends to non-technical internal stakeholders.

jobDescription:
Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Department Overview The Core Platforms & Services team is responsible for the development and operations of critical cloud infrastructure and platform services, in support of Motorola Solutions' public and hybrid cloud-based Software as a Service (Saa S) solutions for public safety customers. This team is part of Motorola Solutions’ Software Enterprise division, which offers secure, reliable and efficient team communications, workflow and operational intelligence solutions for mission critical public safety and enterprise markets throughout the world. Our services leverage Cloud Computing infrastructure on Azure, AWS & GCP to build at scale. Job Description We are seeking a highly specialized Infrastructure Engineer Specialist to lead our infrastructure security efforts with a primary focus on WAF configuration management and building robust Dev Sec Ops automation frameworks. This role is pivotal in bridging the gap between infrastructure stability and automated security policy enforcement across our hybrid cloud environments. Basic Requirements Key Responsibilities
1. WAF Configuration & Lifecycle Management Advanced WAF Engineering: Lead the lifecycle of WAF solutions, moving beyond deployment to advanced configuration management, including automated rule tuning, signature lifecycle management, and high-precision threat policy optimization to minimize false positives. Automated Policy Enforcement: Develop and maintain automated workflows for translating business requirements into WAF traffic policies. Implement CI/CD pipelines that push WAF configurations as code, ensuring consistent policy application across environments. Optimization & Tuning: Proactively analyze WAF logs to identify and remediate complex bot traffic and sophisticated attack patterns, ensuring high availability and optimal performance.
2. Dev Sec Ops Automation Frameworks Security Automation Architecture: Design and deploy automated frameworks that integrate security controls directly into infrastructure provisioning. Use tools like Terraform or Ansible to enforce security baselines as part of the standard deployment lifecycle. Security Observability: Configure SIEM forwarding and alerts for WAF and Network logs. You are responsible for detecting anomalies (like data exfiltration attempts or unusual traffic spikes), ensuring actionable intelligence is derived from system logs. Pipeline Security Integration: Orchestrate the integration of automated security gates (SAST/SCA/Container Scanning) into CI/CD pipelines. Ensure that "Security as Code" is not just a concept, but an automated reality for all infrastructure deployments. Policy as Code (Pa C): Develop and manage automated policy engines (e.g., OPA, Sentinel) to programmatically reject non-compliant infrastructure changes before they reach production Required Qualifications Experience: 10+ years in Infrastructure Engineering or Dev Sec Ops, with a significant track record in high-traffic environments. Primary Tech Stack: Extensive experience in WAF configuration management (e.g., F5, Signal Sciences, Cloud Front WAF) and Nginx/Kubernetes Ingress Controllers. Automation Expertise: Strong proficiency in building Dev Sec Ops automation frameworks. Expert-level skill in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and scripting (Python or Go). Security Mindset: Deep understanding of automated threat mitigation, policy-as-code principles, and cloud-native security orchestration. Hybrid Expertise: Proven ability to manage and automate security policies across complex hybrid or multi-cloud infrastructures (AWS, GCP, Azure). Preferred Qualifications Proficiency in developing custom WAF rules (i Rules, Mod Security). Experience with Git Ops workflows for infrastructure security. Certifications: Certifications such as CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist) or advanced security automation credentials. Travel Requirements None Relocation Provided None Position Type Experienced Referral Payment Plan No EEO Statement Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic. jobDescription: Senior Software Engineer (SSE) – Cloud Media Server Team Overview We are developing a highly scalable real-time communications (RTC) platform leveraging Web RTC to power audio and video workloads. The system is designed to handle large volumes of concurrent sessions while delivering ultra-low latency, telecom-grade reliability, and multi-region cloud resilience. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in real-time media systems, signaling, and cloud-native infrastructure. Primary Skills Proficiency in C/C++, including multithreading, memory management, and low-level networking. Production experience and understanding of: UDP / TCP, RTP / RTCP, ICE / STUN / TURN, and NAT traversal. Hands-on experience in Web RTC internals, SIP / Vo IP signaling, audio/video pipelines, jitter handling, and latency optimization. Hands-on experience with open-source RTC stacks such as Live Kit, Janus, or similar Web RTC platforms. Strong debugging skills in production environments (packet captures, logs, RTP analysis). Secondary Skills Experience with AI voice systems (STT / TTS / VAD). Cloud experience with GCP, Docker, and Kubernetes. Familiarity with distributed systems and high-availability architectures. Exposure to ACE (C++) framework. Job Responsibilities Design and implement scalable audio/video systems using Web RTC, RTP/RTCP, and Web Socket-based signaling. Build and enhance cloud media server/controller components including signaling layer, TURN routing, call control, and media processing. description: Senior Software Engineer (SSE) – Cloud Media Server Team Overview We are developing a highly scalable real-time communications (RTC) platform leveraging WebRTC to power audio and video workloads. The system is designed to handle large volumes of concurrent sessions while delivering ultra-low latency, telecom-grade reliability, and multi-region cloud resilience. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in real-time media systems, signaling, and cloud-native infrastructure. Primary Skills Proficiency in C/C++, including multithreading, memory management, and low-level networking. Production experience and understanding of: UDP / TCP, RTP / RTCP, ICE / STUN / TURN, and NAT traversal. Hands-on experience in WebRTC internals, SIP / VoIP signaling, audio/video pipelines, jitter handling, and latency optimization. Hands-on experience with open-source RTC stacks such as LiveKit, Janus, or similar WebRTC platforms. Strong debugging skills in production environments (packet captures, logs, RTP analysis). Secondary Skills Experience with AI voice systems (STT / TTS / VAD). Cloud experience with GCP, Docker, and Kubernetes. Familiarity with distributed systems and high-availability architectures. Exposure to ACE (C++) framework. Job Responsibilities Design and implement scalable audio/video systems using WebRTC, RTP/RTCP, and WebSocket-based signaling. Build and enhance cloud media server/controller components including signaling layer, TURN routing, call control, and media processing. Optimize performance for low latency, high throughput, and network resilience. Debug and resolve call failures, media negotiation issues, voice quality degradation, jitter, and packet loss. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for production issues. Contribute to performance benchmarking and system scalability improvements. Experience/Education Qualification Experience: 5+ years Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Electronics & Communication, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline (Optional but preferred) Master’s degree (M.Tech/M.S/MCA.) in a relevant field is a plus. Travel Requirements Under 10% Relocation Provided None Position Type Experienced Referral Payment Plan No EEO Statement Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Department Overview Team: Experience Design & Research Who We Are At Motorola Solutions, we believe exceptional customer experiences are born from a deep understanding of user needs, powered by insightful data, and brought to life through thoughtful design. Our Experience Design & Research team is a dynamic, multidisciplinary group of Industrial Designers, UX/CX Designers, User Researchers, and Human Factors practitioners. We are at the forefront of understanding our users and translating those insights into impactful products and services. Now, as we embrace the transformative potential of Artificial Intelligence, we're excited to expand our team with creative minds who can help us redefine what's possible. Job Description The Opportunity As a Senior UX Designer, you will collaborate with product managers, developers, data scientists, subject matter experts and other members of the global UX team to design the next generation of public safety applications. You will be enabling a design-led product development process with a human-centered approach. You will be leveraging the power of design to inspire change and execute the vision. Basic Requirements What You'll Do Deliver pixel-perfect design: Work closely with developers, Product Managers across various teams to deliver high-quality designs that are backed up by UX research. Lead Discovery: Plan and lead customer discovery sessions to uncover unmet needs, align stakeholders, and generate actionable insights. Prototype & Iterate: Rapidly translate abstract concepts into tangible prototypes leveraging AI tools, iterating based on feedback from users, customers, and internal teams. Collaborate Across Disciplines: Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to ensure solutions are feasible, valuable, and ethically responsible. Champion the Vision: Present work, ideas, and strategic rationale in a clear and compelling way that inspires action from both technical and non-technical audiences. Elevate Our Practice: Continuously refine and improve our team's design processes, methodologies, and collaborative practices. What You'll Bring (Basic Qualifications) Bachelor's or Master's degree in HCI, Design, Psychology, Computer Science (with a focus on AI/HCI), or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 6+ years of experience in product design, service design, or a strategic design role. A strong portfolio demonstrating both strategic thinking and hands-on design execution. Demonstrated mastery of planning and facilitating workshops, design sprints, and customer co-creation sessions. Deep expertise in user-centered design methodologies, systems thinking, and design research. Exceptional communication and storytelling skills (verbal, written, and visual), with the ability to distill complex information into clear, compelling narratives. Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools to rapidly visualize and test ideas.
